U.note: Clean empty 32x32 sandbox with four kinds, per-stroke undo, confirm-to-clear, live counts and a good phone layout, but only four plain blocks and an empty start make it less delightful.

V.note: Richest and most polished: textured pixel blocks, sky, trees and pond in a ready seeded world, nine blocks, undo, new world, clear, hover ghost and persistence, all working on desktop and mobile.

W.note: Functional with Place/Erase/Pick/Fill tools and a pre-built ground layer, but the tiny key-number labels are barely legible, the blocks are flat and a full-width ground slab fills the world.

X.note: Seeded little scene with ten block types, working erase tool, Shift/right-click break, Ctrl+Z, cell readout and persistence; blocks are simpler than V but the whole thing is solid and responsive.

Y.note: Works as a basic painter with eight blocks, erase, grid toggle and a generate button, but it starts as a nearly black empty canvas, looks flat, has stray grid artifacts, and its toolbar crowds the swatches with actions.

Z.note: Tidy block box with per-kind counts, hover ghost, placement flash and good accessibility text, but only four kinds, an empty start, and Ctrl+Z does nothing even though bare Z undoes.
